requirements.text: ORDINARY THRESHOLD - Below 75 feet classifies narrow; exactly 75 feet or above classifies wide. Applicable zoning exceptions (the ZR 12-10 wide-street definition's alternate-width and named-street provisions, amended 3/26/2026, and any other applicable exception) are checked BEFORE issuing a final classification; an applicable exception that is not implemented leaves the classification UNRESOLVED, never silently ordinary-thresholded.
requirements.required_harness: boundary tests at 74.99/75/75.01-class values; exception-present-but-unimplemented tests prove UNRESOLVED

requirements.text: DRAFT SOURCE AUTHORIZATION (owner-approved assumption) - For DRAFT purposes, a clear number or recognized explicit bound from the CORRECTLY MATCHED DCM feature may be used, subject to documented source, street-status, and frontage-coverage checks. This is recorded and surfaced as an owner-approved ASSUMPTION about the annotation's applicability - never as a verified DCP guarantee. A nearest-centerline match alone is INSUFFICIENT (the E 96 St segmentation evidence: a frontage may span multiple features; every touching feature must be collected and coverage established).
requirements.required_harness: frontage-mismatch tests (multi-feature frontage, wrong-street match, transition segments) prove refusal to classify on a bare nearest-centerline match; assumption wording in outputs

requirements.text: ONE-SIDED-BOUND RULE - Explicit bounds and ranges are preserved; classification issues ONLY when all values permitted by the accepted reading fall on the same side of the 75-ft threshold. Owner's worked examples: '<75' supports narrow; '>75', '>=75', and '75-90' support wide; '<=75', '60-75', and '70-80' remain UNRESOLVED. All examples remain subject to the R002 checks and R001 exceptions. (Note '>=75' and '75-90' include exactly 75, which is wide per R001 - one-sided at the threshold's wide side.)
requirements.required_harness: range/bound tests covering every owner example plus straddling and threshold-touching forms; property: classify iff interval subset of [75,inf) or (0,75)

requirements.text: UNKNOWN CLASSES AND FORBIDDEN MOVES - Approximate or probabilistic values (e.g. '~75', 'Probably between 80 - 90'), conflicting records, unclear coverage, and unrecognized text remain UNKNOWN and route to map resolution. PROHIBITED: inventing tolerances, averaging varying widths, rounding across the threshold, or silently selecting one range endpoint.
requirements.required_harness: negative tests: each forbidden move has a test proving it does NOT occur (approximation stays UNKNOWN, straddling range never endpoint-picked, no averaging)

requirements.text: PROVENANCE REPRESENTATION - Every classification (or refusal) preserves: the original label text, source version, matched geometry, interpreted bounds, and the classification reason. Unclear cases are resolved from the applicable effective map records (Section Maps + effective Alteration Maps; Admin Code 25-101 posture) where possible; that resolution path is recorded, not assumed.
requirements.required_harness: output-schema tests prove all five provenance fields present end-to-end

requirements.text: UNKNOWN STAYS THE DATA STATE + PER-RULE FALLBACK (reaffirms D-051-R002/R003) - UNKNOWN remains the underlying data state. Each consuming rule must independently justify any fallback; without that justification the rule's result remains not assessed. No universal narrow-fallback is created by this policy.
requirements.required_harness: consuming-rule packets carry per-rule fallback justifications or emit not-assessed; tests prove UNKNOWN propagates
requirements.required_evidence: accepted rule task(s) citing D-052-R006 alongside D-051-R002/R003

requirements.text: VERIFICATION SCOPE + DRAFT POSTURE - The implementation's verification must cover threshold boundaries, range handling, frontage mismatches, and applicable exceptions. All outputs remain DRAFT until G6 qualified legal review (Section 20 hard stop unchanged).
requirements.required_harness: gate reviews confirm the four named verification areas are test-covered; DRAFT labeling verified in outputs
requirements.required_evidence: gate reports of the implementing task(s)

requirements.text: CLOSURE + HONEST RESIDUAL - OQ-3 closes as OWNER-DECIDED upon this directive's recording (closure entry appended to docs/ARCHITECT_REVIEW_QUESTIONS.md; the M4-T013/M4-T015 reports' OQ-3 references remain immutable history). The remaining RQ-005 publisher-convention questions stay accurately marked unresolved; this decision is an owner-approved DRAFT policy and does NOT claim the research established an official universal DCM interpretation.
requirements.required_harness: architect-doc closure entry + RQ-005 cross-reference present in the capture commit; wording keeps the residual open
